name: Western Plaguelands
at_a_glance: A recovering Lordaeron frontier where reclaimed fields, haunted keeps, and contested roads carry the scars of plague wars and later rebuilding.
currently: Argent Crusade patrols and Cenarion restoration teams have reopened key farms and roads, but daily life remains shaped by blight scars, ruined holdings, and unresolved military flashpoints around Andorhal. Convoys still require escort support, local communities rotate watch duties, and nearby necromantic sites continue to force defensive planning in Hearthglen, Caer Darrow, and bordering settlements. The zone feels improved yet fragile, with progress tied to constant vigilance rather than lasting peace, and even routine travel plans still assume sudden disruption windows.
history: Before the Third War, Western Plaguelands supplied grain and trade routes critical to Lordaeron stability. Cult of the Damned infiltration and plague spread shattered that network, turning villages and fields into contested undead territory. The following years brought alternating control attempts by Scourge forces, Scarlet holdouts, and anti-plague campaigns that focused on survival rather than full recovery. Later conflicts around Andorhal reset fragile gains, while wider faction wars complicated local governance. In the Cataclysm period, Argent and Cenarion efforts restarted reclamation, but restored corridors remained exposed to renewed military pressure and recurring necromantic threats linked to regional strongholds. Reclamation phases improved food routes, yet command fragmentation and attrition repeatedly forced costly reversals before local institutions could stabilize. Local militias cycled between emergency defense and harvest protection, while damaged settlements rebuilt in phases that were often interrupted by renewed offensives. This long arc explains why present-day progress appears uneven even when security indicators trend upward.

major_questlines_alliance.title: Andorhal War Campaign
major_questlines_alliance.hook: Alliance forces attempt to secure Andorhal through a sustained campaign that combines plague containment, civilian extraction, supply-line defense, and repeated assaults on fortified undead positions. The arc highlights command friction, battlefield reversals, and difficult tradeoffs between holding ground and protecting vulnerable settlements while pressure escalates across nearby routes.
story_beats: Rally local support and secure supply routes
Contest blight corridors and control points
Resolve command-level conflict after major losses

inclusion_decision.decision_reason: Signature Alliance arc with strong sourcing for Western Plaguelands pilot.

major_questlines_horde.title: Forsaken Counteroffensive
major_questlines_horde.hook: Forsaken commanders fight to hold regional objectives through coordinated strikes, rapid redeployment, and tightly managed plague-war logistics. Their campaign emphasizes attrition, local intelligence, and opportunistic offensives designed to break enemy momentum, preserve strategic corridors, and consolidate authority during prolonged conflict around Andorhal and surrounding fronts.
story_beats: Coordinate strike teams across blighted approaches
Counter enemy pressure with rapid redeployments

inclusion_decision.decision_reason: Mirrored Horde arc essential for faction-balanced pilot storytelling.

major_questlines_shared.title: Hearthglen Recovery Arc
major_questlines_shared.hook: Regional defenders focus on stabilizing Hearthglen through road security, cleanup operations, and coordinated patrol plans that reduce recurring threats from lingering undead cells. The shared arc emphasizes coalition logistics, rebuilding trust between settlements, and maintaining safe movement across farmlands that remain vulnerable to sudden violence and environmental hazards.
story_beats: Protect settlements while restoring regional trust

inclusion_decision.decision_reason: Shared coalition beats spanning recovery corridors justify inclusion.

major_characters.name: Lindsay Ravensun

instances.name: Scholomance

major_landmarks.name: Hearthglen

major_landmarks.name: Andorhal

major_landmarks.name: Caer Darrow
